name: garden-manager
description: Garden fund, beds, plants and harvest tracker

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
